answer: Each epoch the protocol posts I, established keys free this window to attest a first-seen key, sharing no edge. A first-seen submit lands only with k unique attestations from that cut, k=1 plus first-seen already in; those attestors are struck from I. One joiner needs 1; the tenth needs 10, so ten keys consume 55 (triangle n(n+1)/2). I cannot be reset, split, or pre-aged: edges sit on the ledger and a fresh key cannot mint an established attestor. Refuse the cut and the submit is dropped. The cut sits by the juniper peg, a hollow is the missing edge, and each spend takes a marble chip.
